description: BOSZ 2024 release tree at MAST (HLSP), verified live 2026-10-17. Products are (resolution, metallicity) directory slices; each directory interleaves the [a/M], [C/M], and vmicro variants of every (Teff, log g) node, so a stellarlib grid window pins one (a/M, C/M, vmicro-per-family) choice and enumerates its files by the filename grammar.

verified.note_original_sampling: rorig/ holds the original-sampling variant (not a resampled product)

format_notes: resam files are two-column gzip ASCII (Eddington flux H_lambda, continuum) with no wavelength column; rows align by index with the per-resolution wavelength grid file
wavelength grids are log-uniform; r500 spans 500 Angstrom to 31.97 micron in 7500 points, r10000 in 150000 points
upstream clips H_lambda below 1e-6 erg/s/cm^2/Angstrom to zero (continuum to 1); no checksums are published
references: Meszaros, S., et al. 2024, A&A, 688, A197
Bohlin, G., et al. 2017, AJ, 154, 106 (legacy library)
